g.text: Mesh study: endpoint geometry and equivalent-contour lift
Current solver = smooth-contact closure + velocity Kutta. Computed values, not fitted reference data.
N is the total boundary-panel count. Each mesh solves its own cavity contour.
Cavity-force experimental accuracy is not established. Rejected negative-gap free-boundary branches remain in the evidence.
